review: Main debuffer for a charge team. Although he needs a lot of help generating the charge for his skills. W Meursault is an ID that's capable of inflicting up to 8 Defense Level Down on S3, which is a good 20% damage increase. W Meursault struggles a lot with clashes without charge to provide him coin power, additionally he requires Uptie 4 to be realistically viable in a large number of content. Notable E.G.O Synergies: Regret - Due to W Meursault having S2 with 3 coins and S3 with 4 coins, Regret boosts clash and damage of W Meursault massively, in a way potentially putting him rather in damage dealer category and would put him higher in Support category.
